Privacy policy

Who operates this website

This independent project information website is operated by Team Arora, RE/MAX Real Estate Centre Inc., Brokerage. It is not DiGreen Homes’ official website.

Your enquiries

The enquiry form prepares a message in your own email application. Information entered into the form is not stored by this website or sent to Team Arora until you choose to send that email. You may also call or email the team directly.

When you contact Team Arora, the team receives the information you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, home preferences and message. This information is used to respond to your request and provide the project information you ask for. Submitting an enquiry does not subscribe you to an automated marketing list on this site.

Hosting and external services

The hosting service may process routine technical request data to serve and secure the site. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Links to Google Maps, DiGreen Homes and Team Arora lead to external websites with their own privacy practices. This site does not use advertising pixels, analytics scripts or browser storage for form entries.

Contact and privacy requests

To ask about your enquiry, request a correction or request that Team Arora stop contacting you, email parveen@teamarora.com or call 416-910-8923.
